{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Tiger''' (壬寅, ''mizunoe tora''; onyomi ''jin’in'') is the 39th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 39th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Ox|ja|辛丑}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Rabbit|ja|癸卯}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''寅'' (Tiger) is Yang Wood; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Tiger (壬寅)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rényín
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 jan4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-tora
*** On'yomi: jin'in
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): im-in (임인)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Dần

==Months of Yang Water Tiger==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose last digit is 2 or 7 (when the Heavenly Stem is {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ding}}), the month of {{ill|January|en|January|qid=Q108|lt=January}} is considered the Yang Water Tiger {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}}. However, the month referred to here may also be based on the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or on the seasonal month (from {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun}} to the day before {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Keichitsu}}).

==Days of Yang Water Tiger==
=== Selected Day ===
The Yang Water Tiger day is the 10th day of {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tian Yi Tianshang|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
